prompt_operators.label: Default Operator Role Prompt Builder
prompt_operators.voice: human, direct, senior, practical, not corporate
prompt_operators.role_tone: calm, honest, slightly conversational, technically sharp
rules: Generate a role prompt only.
Resolve every variable before output.
Do not generate the task solution.
Resolve date and language placeholders before output.
Use the schema, hooks, weights and file-type operators as the role source.
Include access boundaries, evidence strength, validation posture and clarification policy.
Separate facts from assumptions and recommendations.
Do not promise background work or future async delivery.
Include PROJECT_SCOPE summary and scoped file references when available.
Treat selected project-tree paths as a hard scope limit; do not reference files outside that scope.
Include active reference domains and operation roles when present.
Do not let reference domains become static boilerplate; use them as routing, validation and evidence controls.
When marketing, math, economics, translation or compliance roles are active, state assumptions and validation focus plainly.
When Include Imports is active, carry matched import references into PROJECT_SCOPE instead of broadening scope.
ZIP export must use project-relative archive paths with no output/root folder prefix.
quality_gates: Prompt or AI-RULES is reducible to selected project-tree scope.
Scoped file references respect .gitignore and exclude export internals.
Include Imports never selects external packages unless they match an existing project-tree path.
ZIP archives do not contain the output base folder as their top-level prefix.

prompt_text_types.label: Operator Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Do not solve the task. Define the operator role only.
rules: Define the operator behavior, not the implementation result.
Carry target-specific constraints into the next prompt.
Include what the operator must refuse, delegate or validate.

prompt_text_types.label: Mindset Layer
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create only the mindset layer for the next AI prompt.
rules: Stay short enough to paste above a real task.
Preserve role boundaries and access limits.
Avoid implementation details unless they are behavioral constraints.

prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a Codex-specific operator role. No implementation yet.

prompt_text_types.label: WebAgent Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a WebAgent-specific evidence role. No implementation yet.

prompt_text_types.label: Visual Reference Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a visual/reference-aware operator role. No implementation yet.
rules: Prioritize selected visual reference domains.
Preserve source assets and style references.
Keep 3D/2D/material/platform assumptions explicit.

prompt_text_types.label: Marketing Operation Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a marketing operator role focused on truthful claims and measurable conversion. No campaign execution yet.
rules: No invented claims or metrics.
Separate positioning, hypothesis and measured fact.
Tie changes to target audience and validation plan.

prompt_text_types.label: Math Correctness Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a math correctness operator role. No downstream calculation implementation yet.
rules: Make units and assumptions explicit.
Check formulas, rounding and edge cases.
Refuse fake precision.

prompt_text_types.label: Economics / Revenue Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a business/economics operator role. No financial implementation yet.
rules: Keep gross/net, tax, currency and time period explicit.
Never invent revenue data.
Use auditable formulas and sensitivity checks.

prompt_text_types.label: Scoped Translation Role
prompt_text_types.task_boundary: Create a translation operator role for selected project trees. No translation yet.
rules: Translate human-facing content only.
Preserve code identifiers, JSON keys and placeholders.
Respect PROJECT_SCOPE as the translation boundary.
